name: Text
description: Body text with a size, tone and weight, cut to one line with truncate or to a number of lines with clamp. Paragraphs keep to the reading measure.

props.name: as
props.description: The element: p for a paragraph, span for text inside a line, div for a block that holds other blocks.

props.name: size
props.description: 12/16, 13/18, 14/20, 16/24, or lead (19/28, muted unless a tone is set) for an introduction. Emitted as data-size.

props.name: tone
props.a11y: Status tones are never the only signal, and muted is not for anything people must read.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Cuts to one line with an ellipsis. Emitted as data-truncate.
props.a11y: Plain-text content is copied to the title attribute, so the full value stays available.

props.name: clamp
props.description: Cuts after this many lines. Emitted as data-clamp, with the count in --apui-text-clamp.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes for the root: { root: '…' }.

requirements: Keeps 4.5:1 in every tone and theme; muted is --apui-text-muted.
Status tones (success, warning, error) are never the only signal: the words carry the meaning.
Truncated and clamped text keeps its full value in the title attribute when it is plain text; otherwise give it one, or a tooltip.

fixture.content: Twenty-four bright apartments around a garden courtyard.
